regions.region: page 7 left column, lines 1–9: continuation of regioselective desilylation to (E)-6
regions.finding: The original image completes the page-6 BF3·2HOAc experiment: TLC completion, NaHCO3/water quench at -20 °C, warming, Et2O extraction, Na2SO4 drying, filtration, concentration, 100:1 petroleum ether/Et2O chromatography, and isolated (E)-6 (23.2 mg, 96%, E/Z 97:3). This enriches the existing Scheme 4 record rather than creating a duplicate.

regions.region: page 7 left column, section 2: preparation and characterization of (Z)-7
regions.finding: One existing Scheme 4 experiment is detailed: (Z)-2b (29.7 mg, 0.1 mmol), Selectfluor (54.0 mg, 0.15 mmol, 1.5 equiv), THF (1 mL), and TBAF in THF (0.11 mL, 1 M, 0.11 mmol, 1.1 equiv) under nitrogen at room temperature for 20 min, followed by silica filtration and chromatography to give (Z)-7 (21.9 mg, 96%). Characterization is not a second preparation.

regions.region: page 7 left column, Electrophilic Fluorination section: preparation and characterization of (E)-8
regions.finding: One existing Scheme 4 experiment is detailed: (Z)-2b (31.3 mg, 0.1 mmol), CH3CN (1 mL), NaHCO3 (8.2 mg, 0.1 mmol, 1 equiv), and Selectfluor (56.4 mg, 0.15 mmol, 1.5 equiv) in a sealed pressure vessel at 90 °C for 15 min, with silica filtration and chromatography affording (E)-8 (24.5 mg, 95%). Characterization is not a second preparation.
